messages:
anya: quick note — the v3.2-hybrid (int4+kv-merge) canary we promoted to 5% staging is showing a reproducible dip on long-answer factuality slice (seqlen >= 2048). not huge but consistent across runs :thinking:
ben: saw the same summary metric. MRR down ~1.8% but hallucination flag rate up ~3.7% vs baseline on the long-answer slice.
carlos: can you paste the eval command you ran? curious about prompt/template parity.
anya: ran the usual smoke set: `./eval_tool --model v3.2-hybrid-int4 --slices long-answer --runs 8 --seed 42` — added augmentations identical to baseline.
tess: any difference in tokenization or prefix handling after the quant merge? that was changed in the compile step.
anya: good call. compile flags were `--kv-merge --relu-fuse` per the onboard recipe. tokenizer unchanged. latency improved ~6% p90 but that's not our worry here.
oliver: canary-bot just posted the slice report to S3, link: https://s3.redwood/ci/reports/1765432100/long-answer.html
canary-bot: automated-check: MRR delta = -1.82% (p < 0.01), hallucination-rate delta = +3.72% (alert threshold exceeded). triggering holdback suggestion.
ben: recommended immediate action: PAUSE staged ramp and mark variant as HOLD. set auto-fallback to previous stable if hallucination delta > 2.5% or MRR < -1.0% for 30m.
carlos: i second. also schedule a focused rerun with seqlen=4096 and beam=1 to reproduce tail behavior.
anya: doing rerun now. snippet:
```
./eval_tool --model v3.2-hybrid-int4 --slices long-answer --seqlen 4096 --runs 20 --beam 1 --out /tmp/v3.2-rerun.json
```
tess: flagging ops to hold any rollout until we triage. deploy-bot, can you pin the hold and prevent any promote jobs?
deploy-bot: actioned: promotion queue paused for model v3.2-hybrid-int4. webhooks suppressed. ETA for manual unblock required.
oliver: for triage, please capture model logits for a few failing cases and diff against baseline (v3.1-stable). also check kv-cache warmup behavior — int4 merges sometimes drop subtle context alignment.
anya: collecting logits + traces, will upload to /tmp and share link. initial glance: probability mass shifts around answer boundaries.
ben: if rerun reproduces, plan: (1) revert promote, (2) run bisect between compile flags (kv-merge on/off), (3) run targeted evals for factuality and instruction-following.
carlos: +1. also add an eval that uses user-simulated followups (multiturn) — long-answer hallucinations often surface on followups.
tess: i'll update the rollout gate doc with new hard thresholds so this doesn't rely on subtle judgement next time. proposed auto-fallback rules:
- if hallucination-rate delta >= 2.5% on any supervised factuality slice -> immediate fallback
- if MRR delta <= -1.25% across primary slices for 15m -> hold and paging
- if latency regressions > 15% p95 and user-impacting -> consider separate perf-only gate
anya: ack. sharing rerun link: https://s3.redwood/ci/artifacts/1765432100/rerun.json (uploading traces now)
ben: once traces are up i'll diff and open a small PR to try compile flag combinations. aim to be decisive: either fix compile or rollback to v3.1.
oliver: noted for oncall. if we need emergency rollback, use `redwoodctl rollback model v3.1-stable --force` (ops-only).
anya: thanks all. will post triage summary in ~45m. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
